The infrastructure agents move in coordination — when multiple high-tier players simultaneously rotate away from an asset, that's a structural signal to reduce concentration immediately, not hold hoping for further upside. Early exit at 60% profit is superior to holding for 100% profit that never materializes because retail liquidity dries up.
